title: Book
description: Audiobook record returned by get_book_command and get_books_list_command. Extends the pre-feature model with four new nullable fields added by the scanner-optimization feature.

title.description: Album title from ID3 TALB tag. Primary key.

relative_cover_path.description: Path to cover image, relative to the active absolute root. Null if no cover found.

author_name.description: Author name from ID3 TPE2 (album artist) tag.

create_date.description: Creation timestamp from the first MP3 file's filesystem metadata.

read.description: User-set read flag. Null for books never marked by the user.

score.description: User rating 1-10. Null for books never rated.

relative_file_path.description: Path to the first MP3 file in the book directory, relative to the active absolute root.

duration_seconds.description: NEW (scanner-optimization). Total listening duration in whole seconds. Null for rows created before this feature. 0 only when all files were unreadable.

duration_is_estimated.description: NEW (scanner-optimization). False = duration read from TLEN tags for every file. True = at least one file used file-size/bitrate estimation. Null for rows created before this feature.

file_count.description: NEW (scanner-optimization). Number of .mp3 files in the book directory. Null for rows created before this feature.

orphaned.description: NEW (scanner-optimization). True = the book's resolved file path no longer exists on disk. False = path confirmed present on last scan. Null = orphan check never run (pre-feature rows).
